interactions.intention: Find names and elevations of mountains in countries where Hazaran is located.

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT MM.NAME, MM.ELEVATION FROM MONDIAL_MOUNTAIN MM JOIN MONDIAL_GEO_MOUNTAIN MGM ON MM.NAME = MGM.MOUNTAIN WHERE MGM.COUNTRY = 'IR'

interactions.speaker: User
interactions.utterance: What is the province of these mountains?
interactions.intention: Find the province of those mountains.

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT MGM.PROVINCE FROM MONDIAL_GEO_MOUNTAIN MGM WHERE MGM.MOUNTAIN IN (SELECT MM.NAME FROM MONDIAL_MOUNTAIN MM JOIN MONDIAL_GEO_MOUNTAIN MGM ON MM.NAME = MGM.MOUNTAIN WHERE MGM.COUNTRY = 'IR')

interactions.speaker: User
interactions.utterance: What is the government type of the countries where these mountains are located?
interactions.intention: Find the government type of countries where those mountains are located.

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT MP.GOVERNMENT FROM MONDIAL_POLITICS MP WHERE MP.COUNTRY IN (SELECT MGM.COUNTRY FROM MONDIAL_GEO_MOUNTAIN MGM WHERE MGM.MOUNTAIN IN (SELECT MM.NAME FROM MONDIAL_MOUNTAIN MM JOIN MONDIAL_GEO_MOUNTAIN MGM ON MM.NAME = MGM.MOUNTAIN WHERE MGM.COUNTRY = 'IR'))

interactions.speaker: User
interactions.utterance: What are the countries and provinces of rivers listed in your dataset?
interactions.intention: Show the countries and provinces of rivers in the dataset.

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT COUNTRY, PROVINCE FROM MONDIAL_GEO_SOURCE ORDER BY COUNTRY ASC, PROVINCE ASC

interactions.speaker: User
interactions.utterance: Which lakes are connected to rivers and their countries?
interactions.intention: Find lakes connected to rivers and their countries.

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT MG.COUNTRY, MG.PROVINCE, MG.RIVER, MRT.LAKE FROM MONDIAL_GEO_SOURCE MG JOIN MONDIAL_RIVER MR ON MG.RIVER = MR.NAME JOIN MONDIAL_RIVERTHROUGH MRT ON MR.LAKE = MRT.LAKE ORDER BY MG.COUNTRY ASC, MG.PROVINCE ASC

interactions.speaker: User
interactions.utterance: What are the lengths of these rivers?
interactions.intention: Show the lengths of these rivers.

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT MR.NAME, MR.LENGTH FROM MONDIAL_RIVER MR WHERE MR.NAME IN (SELECT MG.RIVER FROM MONDIAL_GEO_SOURCE MG JOIN MONDIAL_RIVER MR ON MG.RIVER = MR.NAME JOIN MONDIAL_RIVERTHROUGH MRT ON MR.LAKE = MRT.LAKE)
